name: Griddle the Grill-Stripe Cat
blurb: Griddle, a toast-brown tabby with dark grill-bar stripes and leaf-green eyes, dozes on the warm patio bricks of the Cat Sanctuary.

name: Cocoa Swirl the Bicolor Cat
blurb: Cocoa Swirl, a chocolate-brown cat with a cream chest, socks and chin, naps in the shade by the Cat Sanctuary fountain.

name: Crinkle the Golden Fry Cat
blurb: Crinkle, a golden-yellow shorthair with a pale cream belly and green eyes, trots the sunny Cat Sanctuary path on tiptoe.
